ems_standard.evidence_quote: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 50001 is a voluntary, internationally developed standard for EnMSs that offers a flexible framework for organizations to integrate energy efficiency into their management practices. ISO 50004 and ISO 50006 recommend several energy performance indicators (EnPIs) for implementing EnMS sustainably [6-8].

enpi_enb_model_types.evidence_quote: According to ISO standards and IEA research reports, four types of indicators exist: energy consumption, a simple ratio (i.e., kWh per ton), a statistical model (i.e., linear and nonlinear regression), and a simulation model for measuring the improvement of energy efficiency and energy performance that can be applied via each boundary.

complementary_methodologies.evidence_quote: The Delphi method and the Analytic Hierarch Process were adopted to integrate relevant expert knowledge in a systematic manner.
